patches.value: Define A_i=π₁(V_i), the first-coordinate projection of V_i⊆F into ℝⁿ.
Define c_s=C_s(E,δ), the infimum of the sums of s-powers of diameters over all Nat-indexed δ-covers of E, as defined explicitly in S002.
For each j,i put N_{j,i}=⌈1/d_{j,i}⌉, a positive integer; since 0<d_{j,i}≤r_j≤1, its partition pieces have length 1/N_{j,i}≤d_{j,i} and N_{j,i}≤2/d_{j,i}.

For D>0 fix 0<s<D. Define C_a(A,δ) as the infimum of ∑'ᵢ ediam(Uᵢ)^a over all Nat-indexed δ-covers. By M008 this is the scale content; for a>0 the empty-set term is zero and nonempty terms equal ediam(Uᵢ)^a. M001 gives H^s(E)=∞, hence for every finite K there is δ₀>0 such that 0<δ≤δ₀ implies C_s(E,δ)>K. Fix 0<δ≤1 and any Nat-indexed δ-cover V_i of F. Put ρ_i=ediam(V_i), finite since ρ_i≤δ. Let A_i=π₁(V_i) and B_i=π₂(V_i). For each t∈[0,1], set W^t_i=A_i if t∈J_i, and ∅ otherwise, where J_i is an open interval enclosing B_i with length at most ρ_i+η_i. If B_i≠∅, boundedness and diam(B_i)≤ρ_i give finite infimum and supremum; enlarging the closed interval between them by total width η_i yields such J_i. If B_i=∅, choose an interval of length η_i. Since V covers F, for every x∈E and t∈[0,1] some i has (x,t)∈V_i; then x∈A_i and t∈B_i⊆J_i, so W^t covers E, and ediam(W^t_i)≤ρ_i. Thus by the defining infimum, pointwise in t, c_s=C_s(E,δ)≤∑'ᵢ 1_{J_i∩[0,1]}(t)ρ_i^s. This is the cover/slice comparison for this arbitrary cover, not an assertion about a selected cover. For ε>0 put η_i=ε2^(−i−1)/(1+ρ_i^s). Extend the inequality to ℝ by multiplying its left side by 1_[0,1](t); both sides vanish outside [0,1]. Let ν=volume.restrict([0,1]); M011 gives ν(ℝ)=1. For every i the set J_i∩[0,1] is Borel because J_i is open and [0,1] is closed, hence its indicator is measurable by the definition of the Borel measurable space (preimages of {1} and {0} are respectively this set and its complement, both Borel). Multiplication by the constant ρ_i^s preserves measurability: the resulting function has just the two values ρ_i^s and 0, with Borel level preimages (or is constant if the coefficient is zero). A measurable ENNReal-valued function is AEMeasurable by taking itself as the almost-everywhere measurable representative. This proves separately for every i the AEMeasurability required by M002; it is not inferred merely from the Borel-set phrase. Integrate the nonnegative pointwise inequality. M009 gives monotonicity, M002 applies to the countable Nat-indexed family just verified, and M010 evaluates the constant left integral and the individual constant multiples, yielding c_s≤∑'ᵢρ_i^s ν(J_i∩[0,1]). By restriction, ν(J_i∩[0,1])=volume(J_i∩[0,1]). This set is contained in a closed interval of length ≤ρ_i+η_i (use the enclosing interval for nonempty B_i, and a singleton bound when the intersection is empty); M013 monotonicity and M011's interval-volume formula imply ν(J_i∩[0,1])≤ofReal(ρ_i+η_i). Therefore c_s≤∑'ᵢρ_i^(s+1)+∑'ᵢη_iρ_i^s≤∑'ᵢρ_i^(s+1)+ε, since η_iρ_i^s≤ε2^(−i−1) and these weights sum to 1. Let ε tend to zero (if the cover's cost is infinite the comparison is immediate) to obtain C_s(E,δ)≤∑'ᵢρ_i^(s+1) for this arbitrary cover V. Taking the infimum over exactly all Nat-indexed δ-covers V of F gives C_s(E,δ)≤C_(s+1)(F,δ). As δ tends to zero the left side diverges, so the right scale contents diverge, and M008 gives H^(s+1)(F)=∞. M014 implies s+1≤dim_H(F); taking the supremum over 0<s<D gives D+1≤dim_H(F).
